newsitem.title: USA: Briggs says to buy 3.59 mln shrs at $51/shr.
newsitem.headline: Briggs says to buy 3.59 mln shrs at $51/shr.

text.p: Briggs & Stratton Corp said a preliminary count from its Dutch Auction self-tender offer shows that 3.59 million shares of its common stock have been accepted for purchase at a price of $51 per share.
Of the roughly 3.59 million shares tendered, 1.62 million were tendered pursuant to guaranteed delivery. The self-tender commenced on April 22 and expired on May 20.
Prior to the self-tender, Briggs & Stratton had 28.9 million shares outstanding. After the purchase of shares tendered, the company will have about 25.3 million shares outstanding, Briggs said.
Briggs is the world's largest producer of air-cooled gasoline engines for outdoor power equipment.
